# PEAK Game Wiki

> An independent, source-aware PEAK reference for map rotation notes, item categories, badge and achievement context, co-op questions, and official update links.

## Core Content
- [PEAK Game Wiki homepage](https://peak-game.wiki/): The main reference hub for map planning, items, updates, progress tracking, co-op notes, and FAQ answers.
- [PEAK map rotation guide](https://peak-game.wiki/map-rotation): An evergreen guide to route context, biome checks, equipment planning, and the limits of live-map claims.
- [PEAK biomes list](https://peak-game.wiki/peak-biomes-list): A source-aware list of Shore, Tropics, Roots, Alpine, Mesa, Caldera, The Kiln, Gloom, and Citadel, with terrain-reading notes and a dated map entry.
- [PEAK game update log](https://peak-game.wiki/peak-game-update): A dated, source-aware log of official patch titles, content announcements, map-rotation context, and the current daily-map entry.
- [PEAK achievements guide](https://peak-game.wiki/achievements): A version-aware guide to Steam achievements, in-game badges, progress tracking, custom-run checks, and missing-unlock troubleshooting.

## Common Resources
- [About](https://peak-game.wiki/about): Project purpose, source policy, and independence statement.
- [Privacy policy](https://peak-game.wiki/privacy): Analytics, advertising, cookie, and third-party-link disclosure.
- [Terms and disclaimer](https://peak-game.wiki/terms): Fan-site, accuracy, and external-source limitations.

## Latest Updates
- [Current daily map record](https://peak-game.wiki/map-rotation): The build-time map entry and route context for August 31, 2026.
- [Official PEAK Steam news](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3527290): The first-party feed for Patch 2.03.a and other update titles dated August 27, 2026.
